question: Does Transit Gateway support transitive routing?

options.text: No, like VPC peering it is non-transitive
Yes, it acts as a hub enabling transitive routing

explanation: Transit Gateway supports transitive routing — all attached VPCs and networks can communicate through the central hub without individual peering connections.

question: Is Transit Gateway Region-scoped or global?

options.text: Global — one TGW serves all Regions

explanation: Transit Gateway is Region-scoped. For cross-Region connectivity, you can use Transit Gateway inter-Region peering between TGWs in different Regions.

question: When should you use Transit Gateway instead of VPC peering?

options.text: When you need many-to-many VPC connectivity at scale
When you need the lowest possible latency
When VPCs are in different accounts

explanation: Transit Gateway is ideal for many-to-many connectivity. VPC peering requires n*(n-1)/2 connections for full mesh, while TGW needs only n attachments.
